$comment: FIXTURE: root schema; entry point of the bundle. This $comment is the only one that survives minification. The root title/description must survive in both outputs. The root `required`/`examples` are data arrays inside the (reached) root schema and must survive the tree-shaker untouched.
title: Main
description: Root document of the bundler test fixtures.

$comment.$comment: the comment property is expected to stay - but this comment might be removed.
$comment.title: Comment

whole.$comment: External ref without fragment -> module is kept as a whole.
whole.title: Whole
whole.description: A module referenced in its entirety.

wholeData.$comment: External ref without fragment to a module whose reached schemas carry data arrays/maps/literals and boolean subschemas -> all of that must survive the sweep.
wholeData.title: Whole data
wholeData.description: A data-heavy module referenced in its entirety.

sub.$comment: External ref into a sub-def -> only that sub-def (and what it reaches) is kept.
sub.title: Sub
sub.description: A single definition of another module.

local.$comment: Internal ref -> rewritten to #/$defs/main/$defs/mainLocal, so the root's own def entry must be emitted.
local.title: Local
local.description: A definition of this very schema.

composed.$comment: A new object defined inline in main, whose properties reference *properties* (not $defs) of another module -> only those property subtrees of used-properties-only are kept.
composed.title: Composed
composed.description: An object assembled from parts of another module.

street.$comment: Ref into a nested property of the module -> #/properties/address/properties/street.
street.title: Street
street.description: The street, taken from the module's address.

latitude.$comment: Ref into a three-level deep nested property -> transitively keeps $defs/degrees; sibling 'lon' must be dropped.
latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: The latitude, taken from the module's address.geo.

contact.$comment: Ref to a whole top-level property (with children) of the module -> kept with all its children.
contact.title: Contact
contact.description: The contact block of the module, as is.

nested.$comment: Ref into the nested $defs of a REACHED property of another module -> only that nested def is kept, its sibling is removed.
nested.title: Nested
nested.description: A value defined in a property-level $defs.

middle.$comment: Ref INTO a schema array (allOf/3) of a module -> siblings allOf/0 to allOf/2 must become void placeholders, not null; the index must stay 3; the rest can be safely removed.
middle.title: Middle
middle.description: The middle part of the module's combined schema.

lastChoice.$comment: Ref INTO the last item of a oneOf -> the preceding item must become a void placeholder.
lastChoice.title: Last choice
lastChoice.description: The last alternative of the module's choice.

anyValue.$comment: Ref to an EMPTY schema `{}`. Reached -> must survive the sweep even though it has no keys at all.
anyValue.title: Any value

todoValue.$comment: Ref to a `$comment`-only schema. Reached -> must survive and must NOT be hollowed. Becomes `{}` in the minified output.
todoValue.title: Todo value

annotatedValue.$comment: Ref to a title/description-only schema. Reached -> must survive and must NOT be hollowed.
annotatedValue.title: Annotated value

dynamic-anchor.title: Dynamic anchor
dynamic-anchor.description: A recursive tree node, addressable via a dynamic anchor.

children.title: Children
children.description: The child nodes of this node.

mainLocal.$comment: Referenced from main itself and from used-subdefs-only.
mainLocal.title: Main local
mainLocal.description: A local string definition of the root schema.

not.$comment: This schema is hollow: it was not referenced and only remains as a container for structures that are still in use. Itself must not be used for validation.

used-array-items.title: Used array items
used-array-items.description: A module of which only individual array items and a non-schema value are referenced.

combined.$comment: Only allOf/3 is referenced from main. allOf/0 to allOf/2 are not reached -> they must become void placeholders, never JSON null, so that the index of allOf/3 stays stable; the rest can be removed. 'combined' itself is not reached -> hollowed.
combined.title: Combined
combined.description: A composition of which only the middle part is referenced.

not.$comment: This schema is void: it was not referenced and was removed. It only remains as a placeholder to keep sibling positions stable. Itself must not be used for validation.

allOf.$comment: allOf/3: referenced from main via #/properties/combined/allOf/3 -> kept as a whole, including its internal ref to $defs/keptViaArray.
allOf.title: Combined part 3

b.title: B

geo.$comment: Reached from main via a three-level deep pointer into #/properties/address/properties/geo/properties/lat.
geo.title: Geo

lat.$comment: Deeply nested leaf that is referenced directly from main. Has an internal ref -> transitively keeps $defs/degrees.

used-subdefs-only.title: Used sub-defs only

kept.$comment: Reached from main. Exercises three ref flavours.
kept.title: Kept
kept.description: A definition that is reached directly from the root schema.

shared.$comment: Cross-module ref into another module's sub-def.
shared.title: Shared
shared.description: A value defined by another module.

fromMain.$comment: Ref back into the root schema -> #/$defs/main/$defs/mainLocal.
fromMain.title: From main
fromMain.description: A value defined by the root schema.

chain.title: Chain
chain.description: A value defined further down in this module.

keptCommentOnly.$comment: TODO - Reached from main, but has no structural keywords. Must NOT be removed and must NOT be hollowed; the minified output will legitimately become `{}`.

keptAnnotationsOnly.$comment: Reached from main, carries only annotation keywords. Must NOT be removed and must NOT be hollowed.
keptAnnotationsOnly.title: Kept annotations only
keptAnnotationsOnly.description: A schema that is just an annotation.

not.$comment: This schema is hollow: it was not referenced and only remains as a container for structures that are still in use. Itself must not be used for validation.

used-whole.title: Used whole
used-whole.description: A module that is referenced in its entirety.

withDefs.$comment: A REACHED property carrying nested $defs of which exactly one is referenced from main.
withDefs.title: With defs
withDefs.description: A property that hosts its own definitions.

anyOf.title: Non-zero number
anyOf.$comment: if/then/else are intentionally NOT schema objects.

inner.title: Inner
inner.description: Sibling annotations next to a $ref: title/description are kept, while the sibling $comment is removed in the minified output.

license.$comment: Target is outside the models dir -> not bundled; rewired to a path relative to the root schema.
license.title: License

remote.$comment: Absolute URI -> external by definition; left untouched and not checked for existence.
remote.title: Remote
remote.description: A thing defined by a remote schema.

inArray.$comment: Refs nested inside an array (allOf) exercise the array branch of rewriteRefs: internal, bundled-file and external-file refs must all be rewritten there too.
inArray.title: In array
inArray.description: A composition of several referenced schemas.

sharedByOther.title: Shared by other
sharedByOther.description: A numeric value shared across modules.

used-whole-data.title: Used whole data
used-whole-data.description: A module referenced in its entirety that carries data-bearing keywords inside reached schemas.

status.$comment: `enum` is a data array inside a reached schema -> items must stay literals, never become `null`. `meta:enum` is a non-schema map -> entries must not be emptied.
status.title: Status

level.$comment: `const`, `examples` and `default` are literal data in a reached schema -> must stay as is.
level.title: Level

flags.$comment: `properties` map that contains BOOLEAN subschemas. Booleans are not schema objects, so `subschemas()` never yields them; the sweep must nevertheless keep the keys `anything`/`nothing` with their boolean values.
flags.title: Flags

tags.$comment: `items` is a schema; `uniqueItems`/`minItems` are scalars in a reached schema -> kept.
tags.title: Tags
